answer: Each identity must pass a hardware-bound liveness challenge: every 6 epochs it solves a memory-hard puzzle needing 2 GB of RAM for 90 seconds, and 5 puzzles must be passed before it earns weight. Shale-thin shared servers fail, so a 30-clone farm needs 60 GB at once, a canyon of cost that grows linearly. Verifiers recompute a random 12% of proofs, and a quartz-clear mismatch forfeits the 80 POA deposit.
